# <System> — SADD

## Purpose, users, and scope

Describe goals, primary use cases, boundaries, and non-goals.

## System context

Identify external actors, integrations, and operating environments.

## Components and responsibilities

Describe logical components and link to their CDDs. Include a system diagram when useful.

## Dependencies and interactions

Describe allowed dependency directions, major data flows, and shared contracts.

## Cross-cutting constraints

Describe applicable quality attributes and architectural constraints. Link to detailed specs for measurable requirements.

## Deployment and operation

Describe intended runtime topology and operational boundaries where known.

## Decisions, tradeoffs, and open questions

Link to ADRs and identify unresolved design questions.

## Related documents

Link to CDDs, contracts, and relevant scope documents. If superseded, identify the replacement.
